title: executive-daily-priorities-kyra-2026-03-15.json
content:
03/15/2026 - Daily/Weekly priorities (scratchpad)
Owner: Kyra Patel - CEO
Status: working draft; share with exec team EOD

Top objectives this week:
- Finalize Dedicated pricing tiers + committed discount for enterprise pilot (deliver proposal to finance by Thu).
- Approve Private deployment GA checklist (security gating + docs) and schedule customer pilot kickoff next week.
- Get green light on SLO targets for hosting multi-region rollout (need final numbers from SRE).
- Prepare keynote talking points for startup summit (Apr 2) - focus on "serving-first" thesis + cost controls.

Today (prioritized):
1) 09:00 - Exec stand (15m): unblock any escalations - specifically hiring req approvals (talent ops) and Dedicated capacity beta feedback.
2) 10:00 - 1:1 w/ CTO (Avery): review Dedicated perf regressions on 1.3.0 build; ask for mitigation plan and rollback criteria.
3) 11:30 - Customer call: Acme Health (pilot kickoff prep) - confirm networking/KMS needs and timeline.
4) 14:00 - Finance sync: review pricing proposal draft + 12-month revenue projection for dedicated commitments.
5) 16:00 - Product critique: console rollout UX for route-level tracing.

Quick notes + follow-ups:
- Dedicated pricing: draft includes 10/20/40% commit tiers. Need to model impact on gross margins (Ravi). ACTION: Ravi to send model by Wed EOD.
- Private GA checklist: missing HSM integration doc and SOC2 scoping notes. Assign SSO/KMS owner. ACTION: Assign to Priya (security).
- SRE asks: confirm acceptable tail-latency percentile for 99.9; we may need to relax to 99 for some models to hit price targets.
- Marketing: keynote deck draft due 3/22. Provide 3 talking anecdotes (customer wins + benchmark) - ask growth to pull.

Open questions / risks:
- Will Dedicated committed capacity cannibalize hosted ARR? Need sensitivity analysis.
- Multi-region rollout capacity: do we have enough spare GPUs in EU region for April? Ops to confirm.
- Legal: private deployments in EU require data processing addendum updates. Legal to confirm timeline.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Pull last quarter incident timeline and root causes; want 2 slides showing improvements and remaining gaps. (SRE folder link in Confluence)
- Add short paragraph to press talking points about fallback policies (model variants) - simple non-technical phrasing.

Short checklist (tick when done):
- [ ] Send Dedicated pricing draft to finance (Thu)
- [ ] Confirm Acme Health pilot prerequisites (network/KMS)
- [ ] Approve Private GA checklist + assign owners
- [ ] Review keynote deck draft (3/22)
- [ ] Follow up with SRE on tail-latency policy

References / links to pull before next update:
- Confluence: Q1 roadmap + Dedicated launch plan (see linked_artifacts)
- Jira: JIRA-3492 (Dedicated pricing modeling), JIRA-3571 (Private GA checklist)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/482 (tracing changes)

End notes: Keep this lightweight - share summary with execs after Finance sync. If any blockers appear in morning stand, escalate to Avery and Priya for immediate triage.

-- Kyra
